lessons.reason: This exact replacement resolves both architecture-residency blockers. The initial comparison is explicitly pending until the 80-layer input starts, and the 103-request occupancy bar represents the full 51.5 GiB on the common pool scale. All 383 registered artifacts and four live/frozen source pairs match; 25 registered and seven supplemental prior personal views are byte-identical. The changed sheet and four changed/new native frames were personally viewed. One hundred one independent checks pass, including fresh reruns of the original 80 helper/math cases and actual Canvas geometry and final decision gates. The complete delivered narration and provider timeline are byte-identical to the prior full read; the full affected scene was reread. Secondary settled diagrams and accumulator-label clarity retain honest craft deductions.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Independent request histories share one fixed weight allocation while the live KV region grows.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The same 32 GiB budget and request identities establish the later interventions.
